The classes' portraits of the login screen's cards (3.0.11-beta.178): uaRO's own class art from the uaro.kiev.ua
site's design (docs/design/assets/art/*.png), cropped to 360 x 360 JPEG by tools/class_art.py. Built into ddraw.dll
as resources (src/win/class_art.rc); core/class_art names them by the job.
